newsitem.title: FINLAND: Tamro says Jan-Apr sales fall 1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Tamro says Jan-Apr sales fall 1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Finnish pharmaceuticals wholesaler Oy Tamro Ab said in a statement on Wednesday that group sales fell one percent year-on-year in January-April to 4.07 billion markka.

"The decreased sales of pharmaceuticals in Sweden, caused mainly by the change in the Swedish medicine reimbursement system, which led to the so-called hoarding of drugs at then end of the year 1996, resulted in decreased sales of the first third of 1997," Tamro said, adding its other units had posted "significant increases" in sales.
Tamro's Pharma distribution division's sales fell three percent to 3.73 billion markka. Its sales in Sweden fell 11 percent to 2.35 billion markka.
In Finland, Tamro Pharma's January-April sales increased 11 percent to 1.2 billion markka. @
Sales of the medical and laboratory division rose 40 percent to 227 million markka with acquisitions contributing 33 percentage points of the rise, Tamro said.
Sales of its Kolmi division rose 10 percent to 102 million markka. A business in Germany acquired last autumn acccounted for about half of the growth, it said.
